recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a bounded source correction for the published FHIR-39252 resolution; no additional core source change is needed for the naming decision unless the work group later reopens the resource naming policy.
issue_request: FHIR-39252 was a Published FHIR-core BR&R change request resolved as Not Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked for AdministrableProductDefinition naming to be reconciled with ISO IDMP, and the accepted resolution kept the FHIR resource name while adding Scope and Usage text explaining that the resource corresponds to the ISO IDMP Pharmaceutical Product concept, why "Administrable Product" was adopted in FHIR, and where the IDMP mapping table is found.
initial_application: The issue was applied by 8355c1a3fa, which added the explanatory paragraph to source/administrableproductdefinition/administrableproductdefinition-introduction.xml. Commit 11ef65c37e finalized the ISO 11615/11616 wording, and 3dc992a021 clarified that the adopted name is the name of this resource. The current source retained the paragraph, but its "Medications module" link still pointed to medication.html instead of the medications-module.html module page requested by the Jira resolution.
additional_context: AdministrableProductDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini, and its introduction XML feeds the current resource narrative. FHIR-28581 is related background showing the work group had already considered broader consolidation of medicinal, administrable, and packaged product definitions and instead enhanced the separate resource definitions. Corrected Zulip and Confluence searches for FHIR-39252 plus AdministrableProductDefinition/Pharmaceutical Product/IDMP found no directly relevant community record that changes the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: Changed only source/administrableproductdefinition/administrableproductdefinition-introduction.xml, replacing the paragraph's Medications module href from medication.html to medications-module.html while preserving the accepted explanatory text.
source_changes: source/administrableproductdefinition/administrableproductdefinition-introduction.xml: changed the FHIR-39252 paragraph's Medications module link target from medication.html to medications-module.html.

related_jiras.note: Published issue about reducing medication definition product resource types; it supports interpreting FHIR-39252 as an explanation of the retained AdministrableProductDefinition name, not a rename or merger.
